items.headline: US carrier Theodore Roosevelt Middle East ki ore
items.detail: Upgrah tasveeron ke mutabik USS Theodore Roosevelt 4 November ko South China Sea me dikha; US adhikariyon ke hawale se November ke ant tak Middle East pahunchne ki ummeed hai, jahan pehle se do carrier maujood hain.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran tanav: Hormuz se tel supply par asar — Bharat ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Europe bhar me bomb dhamki, Dublin-Rome flight divert
items.detail: Guruvar ko Europe bhar me ek darjan se zyada udanon ko bomb ki dhamki mili; Dublin se Rome ja rahi Aer Lingus flight ko France ke Évreux airbase par utarna pada, 151 yatri aur 6 crew surakshit rahe; adhikariyon ne inhe shararat bhari jhoothi dhamki bataya, koi khatarnak samagri nahi mili.
items.exam_angle: Europe me vimanan suraksha aur sankat prabandhan — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ethiopia me hinsa, swasthya vyavastha khatre me
items.detail: WHO pramukh Tedros ne chetavni di ki uttari Ethiopia me hinsa se swasthya vyavastha dhahne ke kagar par hai; Amhara aur Tigray me drone hamlo me bachchon sahit nagrik mare gaye aur aspatalon me dawaiyon aur karmiyon ki kami hai.
items.exam_angle: WHO, sanyukt rashtra aur Ethiopia sangharsh — antarrashtriya sangathan aur manaviya sankat ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Canada: 2027 se saalana 3.8 lakh PR
items.detail: Canada ne Budget 2026 ke saath 2027–2029 Immigration Levels Plan jaari kiya; 2027 se 2029 tak har saal 3,80,000 permanent resident ka lakshya hai, aur 2027 ke ant tak 2,00,000 tak asthayi nivaasiyon ko PR me badalne ka upaay bhi hai.
items.exam_angle: Canada ki aapravaasan neeti — antarrashtriya sambandh aur pravasi Bharatiya ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nithya Raman LA ki pehli Asian-American mayor
items.detail: Kerala me janmi Nithya Raman ne Los Angeles ke mayor chunav me maujuda mayor Karen Bass ko haraya; Associated Press ne unhe vijeta ghoshit kiya aur Bass ne haar maan li.
items.exam_angle: Bharatiya mool ki neta ka America ke bade sheher me chunav — pravasi Bharatiya aur America ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Asia bhar me girawat, Nikkei 6% gira
items.detail: America ki girawat ke baad Asia ke bazaaron me bhi badi girawat aayi; Japan ka Nikkei 6% gira, Taiwan 8% gira aur Hong Kong aur Shanghai bhi gire.
items.exam_angle: Asia ke share bazaar aur AI stock girawat — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Wall Street me badi girawat, Nasdaq 5.5% gira
items.detail: America ke share bazaar me 5 November ko badi girawat aayi; Nasdaq 5.52% gira aur correction me chala gaya, jabki S&P 500 4.36% aur Dow 3.44% gira.
items.exam_angle: America ki arthvyavastha aur share bazaar — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bank of England ne byaj dar 4% ki
items.detail: Bank of England ne byaj dar 3.75% se badha kar 4% kar di, teen saal me pehli badhotri; MPC ne 8-1 se faisla liya aur mahangai ke 5% tak jaane ka anumaan lagaya.
items.exam_angle: Kendriya bank aur byaj dar — banking aur arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: KOSPI 8% gira, circuit breaker laga
items.detail: South Korea ka KOSPI subah ke karobar me 8% se zyada gira aur 5,000 ke neeche chala gaya, jisse 20 minute ke liye karobar roka gaya; Samsung aur SK hynix ke share bhi buri tarah gire.
items.exam_angle: Asia ke share bazaar aur AI stock girawat — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Turkey ne teen-desh raksha samjhauta manzoor kiya
items.detail: Turkey ki sansad ne Saudi Arabia aur Pakistan ke saath Mecca raksha samjhaute ko 279 ke muqable 119 maton se manzoor kiya; samjhaute ke tahat ek desh par hamla teeno par hamla mana jayega.
items.exam_angle: Samoohik raksha aur paschim Asia ki suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Serbia me chhatra andolan ko 140 seatein
items.detail: Serbia ke chunav aayog ne antim natije ghoshit kiye; chhatra andolan ki Student List ko 250 me se 140 seatein mili jabki Vucic ki party ko 103 seatein mili, aur 14 saal ka shasan khatm ho gaya.
items.exam_angle: Chhatra andolan se sarkar badlav — loktantra aur Europe ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Saudi ne Pakistan ko $3 billion ki madad badhai
items.detail: Saudi Arabia ne Pakistan ke liye $3 billion ki vittiya suvidha ko uchit avadhi ke liye badha diya; vitt mantri Muhammad Aurangzeb ne sansad ke bahar iski pushti ki, jabki alag $5 billion ki suvidha 2028 tak badhi hui hai.
items.exam_angle: IMF aur videshi mudra bhandar — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Paraguay rashtrapati ne bank sankat par istifa diya
items.detail: Paraguay ke Rashtrapati Santiago Peña ne Ueno Bank ke dhahne ke baad istifa de diya; bank ke lagbhag 30 lakh grahakon ke khate band ho gaye aur unpar aapradhik jaanch aur mahabhiyog ki karyavahi shuru hui.
items.exam_angle: Bank niyaman aur rashtrapati ki jawabdehi — banking aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Brooklyn me aag, 6 ki maut
items.detail: New York ke Brooklyn me ek ghar me lagi aag me 6 logon ki maut ho gayi aur 9 ghayal hue, jinme 3 firefighter aur 2 police adhikari shamil hain; aag ke kaaran ki jaanch chal rahi hai.

items.headline: Eisenkot ko 67 samarthan, Netanyahu peeche
items.detail: Israel me Yashar neta Gadi Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ke liye 67 sansadon ka samarthan mila, jabki Netanyahu ko 46 mile; Rashtrapati Herzog Ravivar ko faisla karenge.
items.exam_angle: Israel ki sansadiya vyavastha aur sarkar gathan — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: FATF ki scam compounds par badi report
items.detail: FATF ne scam compounds se jude avaidh vittiya pravah par nayi report jaari ki; har saal dasyon arab dollar ka nuksan hota hai aur lagbhag 120 case studies me 60 se zyada kshetron ko shamil kiya gaya.
items.exam_angle: FATF, money laundering aur cyber dhokhadhadi — banking aur arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: France bank se €100 million cyber chori
items.detail: France ke Credit Mutuel Arkea bank par cyber hamle me hackers ne lagbhag 100 million euro ki farzi len-den ki; grahakon ke khate surakshit rahe aur Paris prosecutor ne jaanch shuru kar di hai.
items.exam_angle: Banking cyber suraksha aur digital dhokhadhadi — banking exams ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hasina: December me Bangladesh lautungi
items.detail: Bangladesh ki poorv pradhanmantri Sheikh Hasina ne AP ko bataya, maut ki saza ke bawjood December me Bangladesh lautne ka faisla nahi badla; giraftari ya maut ka khatra bhi sweekar hai.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh ki rajneeti aur Bharat-Bangladesh sambandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Komyshuvakha hamle me marne wale 42 hue
items.detail: Zaporizhzhia ke Komyshuvakha gaon me Somvar ko sahayata kendra par hue Russian hamle me marne walon ki sankhya 42 ho gayi; 33 log abhi bhi malbe ke neeche dabey hain aur bachav ka kaam jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur nagrik suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
